title.en: "Akage no Yakutatazu" to Kubi ni natta Maryokunashi no Majo desu ga, "Yakusou no Chishiki ga Hanpanai!" to Ouritsu Kenkyuujo ni Soku Saiyou Saremashita.

altTitles.ja: 「赤毛の役立たず」とクビになった魔力なしの魔女ですが、「薬草の知識がハンパない！」と王立研究所に即採用されました

description.en:
“Lugina, you’re fired starting today!”

With those harsh words, Lugina, the red-haired girl, was kicked out of her job as a witch in the herbal workshop — simply because she had no magical power. Even her skill in potion-making was mocked by everyone around her.

In just a moment, Lugina lost her job, her home, and her future…

Wandering aimlessly, she happens to meet a strange and eccentric nobleman named Eric, who becomes fascinated by her vast knowledge of medicinal herbs.

Impressed, he tells her:
“Your knowledge of herbs is incredible! Would you like to work with me at the Royal Institute I founded?”

Lugina, who had never been praised by anyone in her life, is stunned — but shyly and curiously accepts his offer.

However, Eric’s offer wasn’t just about a job…
As time passes, this unusual nobleman starts to draw closer to her, surrounding her with a special kind of care unlike anything she’s ever known.

A story of a simple girl without magic… yet far more precious than anyone realizes.
And a love story that blossoms between an outcast witch and a nobleman who’s unlike anyone else.
